text:
alice: deploy-bot paused the EU rollout at 50% due to p95 latency surge (~420ms). seeing alert :warning:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Canary=25% -> paused at 50%. Alert: p95 420ms (+180ms)
ben: digging into traces, gpu-3 shows elevated kvcache miss rate, correlates with recent kernel flag flip.
dave: is this persistent or a transient noise blip? we need to know before auto-unwind.
alice: consistent for ~6m across our regression prompt set.
carla: business impact? any user-facing errors or only latency? 
ben: only latency right now; SLAs could be impacted if it holds.
carla: decision time: auto-unwind or manual rollback and pin?
dave: leaning manual rollback. auto-revert could flip-flop if metric noise continues.
alice: +1 manual rollback and keep pin until we triage.
ben: initiating manual pin to v2.9.1 for eu: `rwctl rollout set --region eu --version v2.9.1 --pin --reason "p95 regression"`
deploy-bot: Accepted. Staged unwind scheduled: 50% -> 25% (3m), 25% -> 0% (5m).
adam: oncall here, holding related infra changes and increasing alert sensitivity.
dave: rolling back to 25% now, p95 dropping toward 210ms.
ben: once rollback finishes we'll replay the failing prompt set in staging with kv instrumentation: `INSTRUMENT_KV=1 ./ci/run_prompt_set.sh regress-2024-09`
alice: drafting short release-note blurb: "Emergency pin to v2.9.1 in EU after p95 latency regression; investigating kv cache/kernel interaction."
carla: prepping CS/Legal blurb for enterprise customers on heavy traffic. I'll send after rollback completes.
ben: I'll open an investigative ticket with traces, kernel diff, and kvcache histograms. hypothesis: new kernel flag interacts badly with our kv eviction heuristic.
carla: add postmortem checklist: timeline, rollback criteria, telemetry gaps, customer comms, patch plan.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete. Target version v2.9.1 pinned in eu region.
dave: monitoring; will keep bridge open 30m and close if stable.
alice: don't auto-unpin. keep pin until we have a validated patch or safe kernel rollback.
ben: filing issue and tagging eng-runtime + eng-sre with logs and next steps.
carla: once the issue link is up I'll update internal incident doc and notify CS/Legal.
adam: standby if you need extra capacity reroutes.
carla: closing thread when postmortem link is posted. good work, quick and coordinated. :thumbsup:
